bootstrap.definition: Percentile bootstrap over queries. Market means and the hull are recomputed on each resample. The CI is an interval estimate, not a significance test (see statistics.bootstrap.SIGNIFICANCE_NOTE). bootstrap_share_quality_advantage_le_zero is the share of *successful* resamples with advantage <= 0; failed resamples are excluded from that share (not a p-value).

note: No remote fetches. RouteLLM per-query GSM8K is audited only if a local CSV already exists; otherwise the committed Stage 9 summary is recorded.
